The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-indexed arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or the option. For an array with a flat, tuple-valued snapshot index and suitable auxiliary level coordinates, this converts the index to a MultiIndex before pandas conversion, changing the returned index structure relative to the base implementation even under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`.
